Published: https://laoujin.github.io/Atlas/research/2026-06-03-it-conferences-and-tech-events-in-d-nia/

**What the research found:** Dénia has no standalone IT conference circuit. The local tech scene is two things — a monthly WordPress meetup (631 members, 61 events, every 3rd Thursday at Knowhere Coworking) and a brand-new annual student hackathon (inaugural April 2026). The nearest serious conference cluster is Valencia 90 km north, where the Valencia Digital Summit and PGConf.EU both land on October 20-23, 2026 — an easy day-trip or overnight extension from Dénia. Alicante (80 km) has an active 3,331-member generalist tech meetup with regular after-work sessions.
